# Generation Safety

## Overwrite policy

| Path | Regeneration |
|---|---|
| `e2e/contracts/*.generated.*` | Overwrite |
| `e2e/specs/generated/**` | Overwrite |
| `e2e/specs/curated/**` | Never |
| `e2e/data/test-data-adapter.ts` after user implementation | Never unless still the throw stub |
| `playwright.config.ts` | Update only with confirmation if it already exists |
| App source, Prisma, seeds | Never |

Mark generated files with:

```ts
/* generated by playwright-pom-framework-generator — do not edit */
```

## Phases

0. Preflight, parse, non-writing plan
1. Normalize model; stop on fatal ID errors
2. Locator reconciliation
3. Passive scaffold
4. Auth/fixture/data boundaries
5. Specs (active + skipped)
6. Static verification
7. Optional runtime (user-configured)
8. Browser/CI expansion only after Chromium baseline

## Confirmations required

- Adding `@playwright/test`
- Creating/replacing `playwright.config.ts` when one exists
- Running auth setup
- Running any seed or DB reset
- Enabling mutating tests
- Expanding to Firefox/WebKit/CI

## Secrets

Scan generated files for:

- password literals
- `auth_token=`
- private keys
- hardcoded emails matching seed accounts (warn)

Fail generation if secrets are emitted.

## App isolation

E2E code must not import:

- `*.server.ts`
- Prisma client
- env files with secrets

Route lists may be copied as string constants, not imported from generated `routeTree.gen.ts` if that pulls server graph—prefer a thin `e2e/support/routes.ts`.
